# Release v3.4.3

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-09-23 12:10 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **release:** read the bumped version from its tag, author it as the releaser, and undo a failed bump (#485)

  `cidx release create` no longer assumes a `VERSION` file: the new version is
  read from the tag `cz bump` puts on its commit, so any commitizen
  `version_files` configuration works (a `Cargo.toml`-only project included).
  The bump is authored with your host `git config user.name` / `user.email`
  (an identity declared in the action's env still wins; with none the release
  is refused before the container runs). And a bump that fails once the
  container has started now leaves the base branch exactly as it found it — no
  stranded local commit or tag (#484).
